director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter cricket ground ki boundary se samjhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

Cricket pitch ek lamba rectangle hoti hai, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Pitch ke ek kone se chalna shuru karo, kinaare-kinaare chalo aur wapas usi kone par pahuncho, toh jitni doori tay hui, wahi pitch ka parimap hai.
haan samajh gayi
